explore.title: Explore the
explore.description: Read Scripture free in 400+ translations, with no account. Every chapter keeps its context beside the text: who is in it, and what each word means.
explore.multipleTranslationsDesc: Read in many languages and versions — King James, World English, Berean Standard, American Standard, Reina-Valera, and hundreds more.
explore.easyNavigationDesc: Jump to any book or chapter instantly, and keep moving with prev/next that carries you across book boundaries.
explore.seoOptimizedDesc: Every chapter and every Bible character has its own link — send a friend straight to the passage.
explore.clickToPreview: Click any Bible to see the reader preview →

verses.1: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
verses.2: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
verses.3: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
verses.4: And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness.

explore.contextPanelDesc: Open the chapter panel to see everyone named in the passage, and highlight any word for its definition and the Hebrew or Greek word behind it.

hero.title: Study the Bible,
hero.description: Every chapter opens with its context beside it: the people in the passage, the Hebrew and Greek behind each word, and your notes on the verse. Read it, listen to it, or type it out word by word, and follow a study plan built around what you want to understand.

studyPlans.title: Learn With
studyPlans.description: Describe what you want to understand and get a structured plan, passage by passage and session by session, with your progress kept as you go. Or start one of the ready-made plans and stories.
studyPlans.customDurationDesc: From quick daily devotionals to in-depth multi-week studies, tailor your plan to fit your schedule.
studyPlans.adjustableDepthDesc: From beginner-friendly introductions to theological deep dives for seasoned scholars.
studyPlans.thematicExplorationDesc: Focus on specific themes like forgiveness, leadership, or end times prophecy.
studyPlans.whatToStudy: What would you like to study?

features.title: Go deeper into
features.description: The people in the text, the words behind it, three ways to take it in, and a place to keep and share what you find.

scriptureHD.title: Scripture in HD
scriptureHD.description: Character profiles, cited timelines, and the people behind every chapter.
scriptureHD.modalDescription: Know who you are reading about, not just what happened.
scriptureHD.preview1Desc: Browse every person named in Scripture, with their alternate names, dates, and every passage they appear in — free and open to everyone at /bible/people.
scriptureHD.preview2Desc: See a person's arc across Scripture and how they connect to everyone around them. Every claim is cited to a real verse mention — nothing invented.
scriptureHD.preview3Desc: Names light up inside the text as you read. Tap one to open their profile without losing your place in the chapter.
scriptureHD.preview4Desc: Highlight any word to read its definition and the Hebrew or Greek word behind it, from Strong's lexicon. Spanish Bibles are defined in Spanish.

multiModal.title: Multi-Modal Bible
multiModal.description: Read it, hear it, or type it — the same chapter, three ways.
multiModal.modalDescription: Engage with God's Word in the way that works best for you.
multiModal.preview1Desc: A calm, typeset reading mode with nothing competing for your attention — just the text, your notes, and the people in the passage.
multiModal.preview2Desc: Listen to any chapter with two voices, adjustable speed, and verse-by-verse highlighting that follows along. Download for offline listening on your commute.
multiModal.preview3Desc: Type Scripture out word by word with live speed and accuracy. Slower than reading, and that is exactly the point.

studyNotes.title: Study, Notes & Discussion
studyNotes.description: Study plans, notes that stay on the verse, and discussion on the passage.
studyNotes.modalDescription: Structure for your study, a place to keep what you find, and others to talk it through with.
studyNotes.preview1Desc: Describe what you want to learn and set the length and depth. You get a passage-by-passage plan you can work through session by session, and regenerate any time.
studyNotes.preview2Desc: Attach a note to a single verse, a chapter, a whole book, or a translation. Search across all of them and jump straight back to the passage.
studyNotes.preview3Desc: A fresh verse each day and a streak that counts the days you showed up, with an optional daily reminder by email.
studyNotes.preview4Desc: Start a discussion on a verse, a chapter, a book, or a translation, and read what others have found there, with replies and votes.

pricing.title: Choose Your
pricing.description: Reading, the people in every chapter, and word definitions are free. Premium adds study plans, listening and typing, notes, and discussion. Any subscription can be gifted.
pricing.canBeGifted: Can be gifted or shared with a loved one

intro.title: Welcome, {name}.
intro.body: Four questions about where you are with the Bible. From your answers, your first study is ready when you arrive, and you can shape it by talking it through.

familiarity.title: How well do you know the Bible?
familiarity.hint: There is no wrong answer. It only sets where your first study starts.

new.label: It's new to me
new.description: I have barely read it, or never.

some.label: I've read some
some.description: Passages here and there, a few stories I know.

regular.label: I read it regularly
regular.description: It is part of my week, and I want more from it.

deep.label: I've studied it deeply
deep.description: I know its books, its context, its languages.

depth.title: How deep do you want to go?
depth.hint: You can change this on any study, any time.
